snippet.title: Among the Trolls | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Alerted by a strange message from her brother, Anna travels from the US to Finland to visit their grandfather, who lives in the middle of nowhere. Upon arriving she finds his house abandoned and herself drawn into a world where Nordic mythology intertwines with memories of childhood summers spent in the forest.
As Anna digs deeper for clues, she slowly realizes the truth: her grandfather was once a mighty ancient sage whose spell songs helped maintain the delicate balance between the natural world and the supernatural world. Now, those songs are scattered across the land, and something dark has disturbed the harmony he protected.
As Anna ventures further into the wilds and heads toward the icy, shadowed North, she begins to discover some pretty unsettling truths about her family and about herself.
The forest is alive, watching her every step, testing her choices, and reacting to how she treats the land.
Confronted with life-or-death struggles, ancient powers, and creatures born from legend, Anna needs to dig into what really happened to her grandfather. She also has to decide if there's still a way to bring back the balance, or if something much older and darker has already awakened from its slumber."
